QuestInfo.name: Mardi Gras Throws
QuestInfo.0: Would you like to participate in #rthe Mardi Gras Festival?#k If so, please see #bGaga.#k
QuestInfo.1: Monsters attacked the storage room and looted the Beads we were saving up for the festival, stealing everything! If you eliminate the monsters and bring me #b10 Bead Necklaces#k, I'll make you #ra Mardi Gras Feather: Green, Purple, Red#k--whichever one you want!
QuestInfo.2: You have returned with 10 Bead Necklaces that will be used in #bthe Mardi Gras Festival.#k You can participate in this event until #rMarch 1, 2017 8:00 AM#k.

0.0: Are you enjoying #bthe Mardi Gras Festival?#k Well, that makes one of us. As a member of the event committee, I'm worried sick about all the preparations. I could definitely use a helping hand. What do you say?

yes.0: Beads are a must in a Mardi Gras Festival, wouldn't you say? Originally, we had made a bunch of Bead Necklaces for the 2017 Mardi Gras Festival. But vicious monsters broke into the storage room, stole all the Bead Necklaces, and made an incredible mess!
yes.1: I need you to eliminate those monsters and bring back #r10 Bead Necklaces.#k Then I'll reward you #ba Green Mardi Gras Feather, a Purple Mardi Gras Feather, or a Red Mardi Gras Feather.#k I'm counting on you, buddy!

no.0: How could you decline? Come back if you change your mind, but don't come too late. You can only participate until #rMarch 1, 2017 8:00 AM.#k

1.0: No kiddin', you really brought them back. You weren't scared one bit fighting those monsters, eh? A big thanks to you, friend! Because of you, we'll now be able to enjoy the Mardi Gras festivities in 2017 as planned. Here, I have a reward for you.

yes.0: Collect #b10 Mardi Gras Feathers#k of each color, and you can get a #rMardi Gras Mask.#k You can participate as many times as you want in this event until #rMarch 1, 2017 8:00 AM#k, so keep coming back if you want that mask!
